user.title: Connect GroupAlarm
user.description: Enter a GroupAlarm Personal Access Token. The polling interval may be set from 30 to 900 seconds.

organizations.title: Select organizations
organizations.description: Select one or more organizations for this config entry.

arrival_times.title: Arrival duration
arrival_times.description: Optionally set a default arrival duration for {organization}. Leave the field empty to disable it.

feedback_device.title: Select an app device
feedback_device.description: Timed positive feedback requires an explicitly selected active GroupAlarm app device. Only its device ID is stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect GroupAlarm
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new Personal Access Token for the same GroupAlarm account.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure GroupAlarm
reconfigure.description: Enter a valid Personal Access Token for the currently configured GroupAlarm account.

reconfigure_organizations.title: Change organization scope
reconfigure_organizations.description: Select the organizations that should belong to this config entry.

error.cannot_load_devices: Unable to load GroupAlarm app devices.
error.invalid_auth: The Personal Access Token was rejected.
error.invalid_device: Select one of the available active app devices.
error.invalid_organization: The selected organization is not available to this account.
error.no_active_devices: No active GroupAlarm app device is available.
error.no_organizations: This account has no accessible organizations.
error.organization_already_configured: At least one selected organization is already configured for this account.
error.wrong_account: The token belongs to a different GroupAlarm account.

abort.already_configured: This GroupAlarm account and organization scope is already configured.
